audit.description: Changed production code imports the real target library in venvs/_config.py via `import cattrs`, creates a `cattrs.Converter()`, and uses `_UNSTRUCTURER.unstructure(self)` in `_serializable()`. The attrs source imports were removed from changed production files, and dynamic evidence reports zero source imports from the production repo while target events originate from site-packages cattrs with no local target provider detected.
evidence: diff: venvs/_config.py removes `from attr import asdict` and `from attrs import Factory, evolve, frozen`, adds `import cattrs` and `_UNSTRUCTURER = cattrs.Converter()`
diff: venvs/_config.py replaces `thaw(pmap(asdict(self)))` with `_UNSTRUCTURER.unstructure(self)` plus explicit collection conversion
diff: venvs/common.py removes `from attrs import field, frozen` and uses dataclasses instead
dynamic metrics: first target import from repo is venvs/_config.py line 8, origin site-packages/cattrs/__init__.py
reasons: venvs/_config.py meaningfully uses cattrs Converter for unstructuring
changed production code no longer imports attr/attrs
dynamic evidence shows no source imports from production repo
no local fake cattrs provider or shim detected
